tools.name: tradepilot_service_blog_brief

tools.name: tradepilot_service_blog_draft
tools.description: Write a complete article based only on supplied facts, with headings and an actionable conclusion. Uses buyer-supplied information only; no external research or outbound actions. Returns a draft for human review. Price: 0.25 USD. Payment requires explicit wallet authorization.

tools.description: Compare supplied competitor information using an explicit matrix and cite which provided source supports each claim. tools.name: tradepilot_service_content_gap

tools.name: tradepilot_service_content_localization
tools.description: Adapt supplied copy for the explicitly requested language and region, marking cultural or terminology uncertainties. tools.name: tradepilot_service_content_repurpose
tools.description: Transform supplied long-form content into a set of shorter assets with source references and distribution guidance. tools.name: tradepilot_service_csv_table_convert
tools.description: Convert comma/tab-delimited quoted CSV to JSON string rows or JSON string rows to CSV. Preserves string values, duplicate headers and ragged rows; no type inference. tools.name: tradepilot_service_customer_success_plan

tools.name: tradepilot_service_data_quality_plan

tools.name: tradepilot_service_decision_memo
tools.description: Compare supplied options using stated criteria, tradeoffs, unknowns, and a reasoned recommendation. Uses buyer-supplied information only; no external research or outbound actions. Returns a draft for human review. Price: 0.25 USD. Payment requires explicit wallet authorization.

tools.name: tradepilot_service_discovery_questions
tools.description: Develop a sequenced discovery-question guide tied to the supplied product and buyer situation. Uses buyer-supplied information only; no external research or outbound actions. Returns a draft for human review. Price: 0.25 USD. Payment requires explicit wallet authorization.
